notes: Expectations are authored from the actual Bundler3/approve/transfer manifests, Rust Action serialization, and independent ABI integer/offset arithmetic; never from WASM output.
Call tuple order is to,address / data,bytes / value,uint256 / skipRevert,bool / callbackHash,bytes32; every canonical case includes the exact source tuple fields beside fixed calldata.
Call[] routes each child at its own target. The parent value is 999; child values are independent decimal uint256 values, and Unknown preserves them as minimal hex.
Only outer Action meta survives. Known ERC-20 child bodies do not project value, skipRevert, callbackHash, child meta, or child decoder IDs.

skipRevert and callbackHash are carried in ABI input but are not runtime-validated or applied to error behavior. They do not establish actual EVM execution, native value transfer, or callback execution success.

Empty array errors; short and unregistered children remain Unknown with diagnostics; registered malformed ABI rejects the whole request. The first 64 children are interpreted and child index 64 is retained as Unknown with child_limit.

Recursive successes carry exact decoding status/diagnostics. The shared inherited route depth budget applies to Call[] and callback re-entry; this fixture has no callback recursion, which is covered separately by DEC-06c.
Noncanonical outer ABI cases deliberately use bounded small out-of-range offsets/lengths. Normal child arrays have at most 65 elements. Trailing bytes retain existing permissive ABI behavior.

cases.note: Both flags are present in calldata. Current decoding does not simulate or apply EVM revert handling.
Nonzero bytes32 callbackHash is ABI input only; it is not verified, projected, or itself treated as callback calldata.
Every tuple field has an independently checkable position. The short middle leg preserves its own target/data/uint256 value.
Unregistered legs remain ordered Unknown bodies; all-unsupported is not an empty-array error.
Only the four pinned USDC tokens expand standard manifests; a WETH address with transfer calldata has no installed mapper.
